verdict.rationale: Superhuman documents an official MCP server that connects Claude and ChatGPT to the inbox, but nothing shows a user can issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials for an agent. The closest items are adjacent controls (per-send approval and admin governance of connector permissions), not credential scoping, and no public API or OpenAPI spec was found.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
